prompts.name: kk_trainer_sms_phone2
prompts.prompt: The attached image is an iPhone Messages (SMS) screenshot in dark mode. Create a realistic amateur photo, taken with a second phone, of a person's left hand holding a black iPhone upright whose screen displays exactly the attached screenshot. The phone is large in the frame (about 80% of the frame height), slightly tilted, seen slightly from above; the bottom of the phone may be cut off. Background: dim bedroom, blurry, warm lamp light. The screen content must be identical to the attached screenshot: black background, green bubbles on the right, dark gray bubbles on the left, the gym door photo, the same Korean text and line breaks, the same header. Do not add, remove or repeat any message, do not invent any other content. Subtle real-photo artifacts: slight moire, faint glare, a few fingerprint smudges, phone camera noise. No other text, no watermark.
